prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 86.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 83.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 71.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.8%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 68.9%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 31.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Interactive Desktop Pet Interaction Playground: Redesign the home intro screen into an interactive desktop playground where users test controlling, dragging, and speaking to their new pet before finishing setup. (why: Support emails report users being confused about how to control, hide, or interact with the pet after onboarding, and the finish step has a low 68.9% conversion with high drop-off.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Companion Personality Archetype Selection Screen: Introduce a dedicated archetype selection screen before path choice that matches pet traits to desktop companion styles. (why: The mean time for choose_path is 514s, indicating users hesitate when deciding how to configure their companion.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Pre-Finish Cloud Sync Account Link Step: Move sign_in to occur right before the home_intro finish stage to guarantee pet cloud saving immediately prior to desktop launch. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, and moving account sync right before launch ensures state is preserved.)
3: [finish, notification] Quick-Access Desktop Tray & Hotkey Notification: Add a notification badge and key binding guide on the final screen showing how to toggle desktop pet visibility instantly. (why: 3 users emailed about being unable to hide or control their pet post-onboarding, leading to drop-offs on the finish step.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Full-Bleed Visual Onboarding Welcome & Companion Preview: Redesign the initial welcome story screen into a full-bleed interactive visual introduction showcasing animated desktop pets in action. (why: The first step takes a long mean time (514s), requiring a more engaging visual hook to pull users into onboarding immediately.)
